# Safeโอน (SafeOne)
> โอนปลอดภัย ทุกยอดเงิน | Real-time Thai Bank Account & Online Fraud Verification Service

## Overview
Safeโอน (SafeOne) is a privacy-first Thai financial safety platform that allows consumers, e-commerce shoppers, and travelers to verify bank accounts, phone numbers, and seller identities before transferring money.

## Key Capabilities
- **Multi-Entity Identity Graph:** Links bank accounts, phone numbers, LINE IDs, and platform links to detect mule account networks.
- **Privacy-Preserving (PDPA Compliant):** Queries are hashed via one-way HMAC-SHA256. Bank accounts are not stored in plaintext.
- **Official Regulatory Whitelisting:** Cross-references SEC Thailand (ก.ล.ต. Investor Alert & Licensed Entities) and Bank of Thailand (ธปท. Licensed Lenders).
- **Emergency Fraud Response:** Provides instant hotline routing to 15 Thai bank fraud command centers and the AOC 1441 Anti-Online Scam Operation Center.

## APIs (Read-Only)
- `GET https://kohkohkub-production.up.railway.app/api/check?q={query}`
  - Returns verification status, dispute count, and network connectivity indicators.

## Key Emergency Contacts (Thailand)
- AOC 1441 (สายด่วนศูนย์ปราบปรามอาชญากรรมทางเทคโนโลยี 24 ชม.)
- Thai Police Online: https://thaipoliceonline.go.th
- KBank Fraud Hotline: 02-888-8888 กด 01
- SCB Fraud Hotline: 02-777-7575
- BBL Fraud Hotline: 1333 กด *3
- KTB Fraud Hotline: 02-111-1111 กด 108
- TrueMoney Fraud Hotline: 1240 กด 6
